name: Haru no Koi.
source:
Main character is a student on a lunch break. He may choose to speak to his acquaintance, eat alone at the cafeteria or eat outside. Depending on that he will end up with one of the persons there.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名正在午休的学生。他可能会选择与熟人交谈、独自在食堂吃饭或在外面吃饭。根据这一点，他最终会和那里的其中一个人在一起。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
